How do I get an API key?
1. Sign in or create an account at console.anthropic.com.
2. Open Settings → Billing and add credits. A Claude Pro or Max subscription does not include API credits.
3. Open Settings → API Keys and tap Create Key.
4. Copy the key (it starts with sk-ant-) and paste it above. It is shown only once.
Each search uses a small amount of your credits.

ForgeROM never changes your phone. This is a general checklist; always follow the official guide for your device.
Back up everything you care about (photos, messages, app data). Installing a custom ROM erases your phone.
Charge the phone to at least 80 percent and use a good USB cable. Most devices need a computer for unlocking and flashing.
Check that your exact model number, region and carrier are listed as supported. Flashing a ROM made for another variant can brick the phone.
Open the ROM\'s official installation guide (the source button on its card) and read it completely before you start. Follow that guide, not random videos.
Unlock the bootloader if the guide asks for it. This erases all data and can void the warranty. Some brands require a waiting period or an account.
Install the recommended recovery. Many ROMs include their own; otherwise use one of the recoveries from the results.
Flash the ROM exactly as the guide says. If a SHA-256 checksum is shown, verify the downloaded file against it first.
The first boot can take several minutes. If the phone does not start, stay calm: go back to recovery and follow the troubleshooting section of the guide.
Only install APKs matching the installed app\'s signing certificate. Check release notes before updating.

Carrier permission and the OEM unlocking switch cannot be verified by this app. Do not confuse bootloader state with permission to unlock.

Root-only recovery handoff for verified, legacy flashable ZIPs. Requires compatible TWRP or OrangeFox recovery, readable storage, and an official ROM guide. It does not flash system partitions while Android is running.

Verify, queue and reboot to recovery
Superuser access is required for recovery handoff. Without root, ForgeROM only downloads files.

This will verify the ZIP, copy it to Downloads, queue a recovery script and reboot into recovery. Installation may erase data or make the device unbootable if the recovery or ROM is incompatible. ForgeROM cannot verify your recovery implementation.
